apps.name: Intervals: What, Why and How
apps.blurb: An interactive lesson: what intervals are, and how they shape melody, transposition, inversion, singing, tension, chords, keys and atonal music.

apps.name: Modes: The Simple Truth
apps.blurb: An interactive lesson: the same notes from any degree of any major scale, parallel modes, major and minor families, PADMIL in any key, modal key signatures, naming modes by ear from scales and chord progressions, and modes beyond the diatonic.

apps.name: Chord Figures and Symbols
apps.blurb: Spell triads and seventh chords, read them on the grand staff, turn figured bass into chord symbols, and label inversions.

apps.name: Chord Extensions
apps.blurb: Spell 9th, 11th, 13th and altered chords from their symbols, and name them from the staff.

apps.name: Modes
apps.blurb: Spell modes, name them from the staff, find modal key signatures with PADMIL, and review modal pitches.

apps.name: Key Modulation
apps.blurb: Name the modulation method, find and label pivot chords, and judge key relationships.

apps.name: Secondary Function Chords
apps.blurb: A lesson and drills: tell secondary dominants, leading-tone chords and pre-dominants apart, find their targets, and label or spell them in any key.

apps.name: Chromatic Chords
apps.blurb: A lesson and drills on mode mixture, the Neapolitan and augmented sixth chords: spell and label them in any key, find them in progressions, and hear how they resolve.

apps.name: Voice Motion and Polyphony
apps.blurb: A lesson and drills: contrary, oblique, similar and parallel motion, forbidden parallels, SATB ranges and spacing, and textures from organum to canon (with listening).

apps.name: Rhythm Notation
apps.blurb: Complete bars, name meters, fix beaming, and spot syncopation, hemiola and anacrusis.

apps.name: Rhythm Performance
apps.blurb: Read a rhythm, hear the count-in, then tap or clap it. Every note is checked for timing, with levels from quarter notes to syncopation and triplets.

apps.name: Strings
apps.blurb: Violin to bass: open strings and string numbers, natural and artificial harmonics, bowings and color effects.

apps.name: Winds & Brass
apps.blurb: Woodwind and brass instruments, score order and scoring shorthand, valves and partials, mutes and techniques.

apps.name: Percussion
apps.blurb: Drums, mallets and metals: materials, beaters, playing logistics and percussion notation.

apps.name: Score and Parts Preparation
apps.blurb: What professional scores and parts must include, and the typesetting conventions players expect.

apps.name: Orchestration Foreign Terms
apps.blurb: Instrument names and score terms in English, French, German and Italian.

apps.name: Instrument Transpositions
apps.blurb: Which instruments transpose and by how much: read parts at concert pitch, write for any instrument, and transpose key signatures.

apps.name: Ear Training
apps.blurb: Sing intervals above a given note and short melodic patterns (the app listens), name chord qualities, and take melodic dictation.

apps.name: Metronome
apps.blurb: Tap a tempo or pick a traditional metronome marking; set meters, groupings, accents and subdivisions; click or drum beats (plain or swing); silent-bar and speed trainers.

apps.name: Drone
apps.blurb: A steady drone on one note or a chord, in equal temperament, Pythagorean tuning, or just intonation (5-, 7-, 11- or 13-limit).

apps.name: Shadow Tuner
apps.blurb: A tuner that sings a reference pitch back to you while you play or sing.
